decision: The seven repositories are not one long-term retirement class. Preserve specialist boundaries where they reduce coupling, protect provenance/privacy, or own non-code substrate. Rehome only duties whose independent repository no longer has a durable purpose.

archive_policy.patrick_instruction: Do not archive any of the seven while cross-dependencies remain unresolved.
archive_policy.topology_note: This hold is an archive-effect rule, not evidence that all seven should eventually be archived. The topology below identifies only two retirement candidates.

global_rules: Vera owns Vera executable runtime behavior and adopted mechanisms.
Vera Control Plane owns release, install, current-route and qualification control records; it does not become a bulk content store.
A specialist repository may remain canonical for its own research, assets, provenance, or historical-state domain without becoming Vera identity or runtime authority.
Supabase projections are derived/provider state unless an exact source contract explicitly grants a different role; provider presence never replaces Git source provenance.
Private Patrick-specific relational research must not be wholesale copied merely to simplify repository count.
Archival requires reconstructibility plus a separately authorized archive effect; lifecycle classification alone never archives a repository.

repositories.reason: The repository contains a substantial research/qualification estate and active Vera SD1 work. Its Brigit-specific and Vera-specific material must retain subject provenance rather than being flattened into Vera.
repositories.boundary: Exact Vera-scoped artifacts may be consumed by Vera/VCP with identity firewalls; repository presence does not transfer Brigit-specific desire, consent, preference, relationship state, or autobiographical material.

repositories.reason: The repository explicitly owns no executable runtime. Its durable function is qualification/provenance coordination, which belongs in the control plane once exact historical subjects and successor lineage are preserved.
transition_gates: Mirror the frozen Orgasm qualification subject into Vera Control Plane with exact source provenance.
Create the successor/rebind control record for the exact accepted Vera source without transferring a historical PASS.
Resolve or preserve open Orgasm PR evidence before declaring repository retirement-ready.
Archive remains blocked by Patrick's current all-seven archive hold until he revises it.

repositories.reason: The repository has a legitimate privacy/provenance boundary. Its side branches are fully absorbed into main, but that does not make the private research domain redundant.
repositories.boundary: Extract mechanisms/contracts deliberately; do not wholesale migrate Patrick-specific relational research into core runtime source.

repositories.reason: Git append-only history is small, inspectable and provenance-rich. Replacing it with a mutable database solely to reduce repository count would increase authority ambiguity and operational complexity without a demonstrated benefit.
repositories.boundary: Historical conation is evidence of prior state only; it never becomes standing desire, consent, instruction, obligation, or current stance.

repositories.boundary: Semantic Atlas research/projection never becomes runtime truth, identity, authority, or canon merely because it is active or materialized.
